title: C and C++
description: C and C++ projects with CMake: the C toolchain (Clang as zig cc, CMake, Ninja) mounted in; GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: C und C++
de.description: C- und C++-Projekte mit CMake: die C-Toolchain (Clang als zig cc, CMake, Ninja) eingehängt; GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: The C toolchain (cc, c++, gcc, g++, clang as zig cc; CMake and Ninja; it brings zig) comes with the preset (--toolchain cc): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox). Not in the store yet, the start offers to add it (sandbox-ai toolchain add cc: a download, its signature and SHA-256 checked) - on a terminal it asks, with --fix it does, the app asks in its window. Its registries are the ones this preset opens.

It is Clang with Zig's libc headers and libc++: no GNU make (CMake's generator is Ninja), no GNU binutils (nm, objdump), libc++ instead of libstdc++; programs are built against the sandbox's glibc, or static with -target x86_64-linux-musl. GCC and make instead: an image variant, sandbox-ai images new cpp --from claude, sandbox-ai images extend cpp --add-apt build-essential, sandbox-ai build --variant cpp, then --image-variant cpp.
Dependencies from elsewhere than GitHub (a vcpkg or Conan registry, a project's download host): --allow-host NAME on the command line.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
